observation.depicts: Tall narrow crop of the left dashboard panel: search bar, circular textured avatar, u/pjackim label, folder buttons, icon buttons, power buttons and a quote.
observation.text_readable: Readable: "u/pjackim", "Documents", "Success means having the courage, the", "- George Sheehan". All visible text legible.
observation.composition: Portrait crop; panels stacked top to bottom filling frame; quote panel occupies lower third with empty dark space around text; top bar partly cut at top.
observation.tone_and_contrast: Grey-slate background with pastel teal, green, yellow and orange buttons; text in orange/yellow on dark; moderate contrast.
observation.sharpness_and_artifacts: Crisp UI edges and text; smooth gradient background; avatar shows fine woven texture; no watermark or overlays noted.
observation.scan_first_read: A neat stack of coloured launcher buttons with a name and an inspirational quote.

legend.0: Far too few pixels or very soft: detail is mushy or blocky even at the file's native size
legend.1: Small or soft: visible softness or coarse pixels at native size; would look weak enlarged or on high-density screens
legend.2: Adequate: acceptable at native size but with little headroom for enlargement
legend.3: Good: sharp at native size with reasonable headroom
legend.4: Excellent: crisp with ample pixels; holds up when enlarged

legend.0: None of the text a viewer is meant to read can be read
legend.1: Only a few large words are readable; most meaningful text is illegible
legend.2: The main text is readable but secondary text is hard to read
legend.3: All meaningful text is readable with slight effort
legend.4: All text is crisp and effortless to read

legend.0: A viewer cannot tell what the image shows
legend.1: Vague: the subject is faint or ambiguous
legend.2: The subject is identifiable with some effort
legend.4: The subject is immediately obvious and striking

legend.0: The subject is cut off or mostly missing, and/or most of the frame is dead space
legend.1: Noticeable cut-off content or large empty areas weaken the subject
legend.2: Acceptable: some wasted space or a slightly tight crop
legend.3: Well framed: the subject is complete with sensible margins
legend.4: Excellent framing: every part of the frame earns its place

legend.0: The subject merges into the background (nearly black or blown out); parts cannot be told apart
legend.1: Weak separation between subject and background; hard to distinguish parts
legend.3: Good separation between subject and background
legend.4: Excellent: clear, balanced tones and strong separation

legend.0: Severe artifacts dominate: debug overlays, watermarks, cursors, or heavy compression damage
legend.1: Prominent artifacts that a visitor would notice immediately
legend.2: Minor artifacts noticeable only on a close look
legend.4: Clean: no artifacts, overlays or leftover interface residue

legend.0: A two-second glance conveys nothing clear
legend.3: A clear, specific takeaway about the work
legend.4: An instant, specific and appealing takeaway about the work
